meta.title: Foundation Team - Open Healthcare Network Foundation
meta.description: The foundation team operating OHC Foundation, CARE Core, open healthcare infrastructure, AI, product, engineering, partnerships, and ecosystem enablement.

hero.title: The operators building the institution.
hero.body: This page is the foundation team roster. It starts with the CEO and CTO, and is structured so product, engineering, AI, partnerships, documentation, community, and operations roles can be added as the foundation grows.

operatingAreas.title: A small foundation team with high leverage.
operatingAreas.body: The foundation team exists to make CARE reusable, governable, and fundable beyond any one deployment. The roster will expand as roles become public.

productAi.title: Product and AI
productAi.text: Roadmap, workflow strategy, assistive AI direction, and product quality for healthcare users.

engineering.title: Architecture and engineering
engineering.text: CARE Core, APIs, plugins, implementation quality, and platform maintainability.

operations.title: Foundation operations
operations.text: Governance support, documentation, fundraising readiness, reporting, and institutional systems.

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem enablement
ecosystem.text: Implementation partners, hospitals, governments, funders, clinicians, and open-source contributors.

team.title: Foundation operating leads.
team.body: This public roster starts intentionally small and is built to expand. Product, engineering, AI, community, partnerships, documentation, and operations leaders can be added as the foundation publishes those roles.

roster.title: Leadership should be visible, current, and deliberate.
roster.body: The foundation team page will expand as roles are confirmed for publication, with clear accountability for product, engineering, partnerships, operations, community, and stewardship.
roster.signalBody: A public roster helps governments, funders, hospitals, and contributors understand who is accountable for the institution behind CARE and related open healthcare infrastructure.
